title: Man abducted off a downtown street in Concord
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Man abducted off a downtown street in Concord, about 1976 at Concord, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: first there was one a person in conquered California walking in the middle of the downtown streets at 4:00 a.m. had no interest in UFOs but claimed that he had been abducted right off of the street in downtown conquered and and we interviewed him.

plain: A researcher of psychic and unexplained events, Jeffrey Mishlove, says that in 1976 a man walking through downtown Concord, California, at four in the morning claimed he had been abducted, taken by beings, right off the street. Mishlove says the man had no interest in UFOs, and that he and his colleagues interviewed him, and he links the case to a police report and to a man named Ted Owens. He tells it as one of several such cases he looked into himself.
